title: SIDESTORY: TWILIGHT OF WOLUMONDE RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: TWILIGHT OF WOLUMONDE RERUN
EVENT DURATION: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Twilight of Wolumonde event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
[Capitol Spire] Duration: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 27, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Silent Frontier] Duration: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 27, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Winterwisp Way] Duration: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 27, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[BURNT OFFERINGS]

DETAILS: During the event, Burnt Offerings event missions will be available, and the missions can be completed in the event stages. Besides, players can complete side missions to collect Wolumonde Search Warrant and unlock hidden stages.
MAIN REWARDS: 5* Event Bonus Operator Folinic, Leithanien Nights Furniture (Pieces), Aristocrat’s Antique Aureus, Wolumonde Search Warrant.
[AUGUST FAIR]
DURATION: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can use Aristocrat's Antique Aureus obtained from Burnt Offerings and event stages to redeem the rewards in August Fair.
MAIN REWARDS: Folinic’s Token, Leithanien Nights Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the
adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress, First Clear progress, and 5 clue missions' progress in the [Antique Diary] of the original event.
The once only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them.
Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemables will be added.
Operators Suzuran, Ayerscarpe, Folinic, and Click will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, this event will be archived into [Side Story] and become permanently available. [Occupied Area] and [Suspicious Site]
in [Capitol Spire] will both be automatically unlocked, but players will still have to clear the previous stages to progress.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – LISA OF THE VALLEY
DURATION: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, “Lisa of The Valley”, opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Suzuran
★★★★★: Ayerscarpe / Nightmare
★★★★: Click
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Spellbreaker for Mostima
EPOQUE Collection - Starseeker for Astesia
04 VITAFIELD [REWILDER] SERIES CLASSICS NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Lasting Arrowroot – Folinic
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – LEITHANIEN NIGHTS
DURATION: December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Twilight of Wolumonde event rewards and redeem in August Fairs (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from December 17, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 31, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
